statusCodes.name: Continue
statusCodes.description: Request received; continue sending body.

statusCodes.name: Switching Protocols
statusCodes.description: Server agrees to change protocol.

statusCodes.name: Processing
statusCodes.description: Server is processing the request.

statusCodes.name: Early Hints
statusCodes.description: Provides hints before final response.

statusCodes.name: OK
statusCodes.description: Request succeeded and returned content.

statusCodes.name: Created
statusCodes.description: Resource created successfully.

statusCodes.name: Accepted
statusCodes.description: Request accepted for processing.

statusCodes.name: Non-Authoritative Information
statusCodes.description: Response modified from origin server.

statusCodes.name: No Content
statusCodes.description: Request succeeded with no content returned.

statusCodes.name: Reset Content
statusCodes.description: Client should reset the document view.

statusCodes.name: Partial Content
statusCodes.description: Partial resource delivered due to range request.

statusCodes.name: Multi-Status
statusCodes.description: Provides multiple status codes for different resources.

statusCodes.name: Already Reported
statusCodes.description: Members already reported in a previous response.

statusCodes.name: IM Used
statusCodes.description: Response is result of instance-manipulations.

statusCodes.name: Multiple Choices
statusCodes.description: Multiple options for the requested resource.

statusCodes.name: Moved Permanently
statusCodes.description: Resource moved to a new permanent URI.

statusCodes.name: Found
statusCodes.description: Resource temporarily resides under a different URI.

statusCodes.name: See Other
statusCodes.description: Response can be found under a different URI using GET.

statusCodes.name: Not Modified
statusCodes.description: Resource has not been modified since last request.

statusCodes.name: Use Proxy
statusCodes.description: Resource must be accessed through the proxy.

statusCodes.name: Temporary Redirect
statusCodes.description: Resource temporarily resides under a different URI.

statusCodes.name: Permanent Redirect
statusCodes.description: Resource permanently resides under a new URI.

statusCodes.name: Bad Request
statusCodes.description: Malformed request syntax or invalid request.

statusCodes.name: Unauthorized
statusCodes.description: Authentication is required for the request.

statusCodes.name: Payment Required
statusCodes.description: Reserved for future use; payment needed.

statusCodes.name: Forbidden
statusCodes.description: Server understood request but refuses to authorize it.

statusCodes.name: Not Found
statusCodes.description: Requested resource could not be located.

statusCodes.name: Method Not Allowed
statusCodes.description: Request method not supported for the resource.

statusCodes.name: Not Acceptable
statusCodes.description: Response cannot satisfy the Accept headers.

statusCodes.name: Proxy Authentication Required
statusCodes.description: Client must authenticate with the proxy.

statusCodes.name: Request Timeout
statusCodes.description: Server timed out waiting for the request.

statusCodes.name: Conflict
statusCodes.description: Request conflicts with current resource state.

statusCodes.name: Gone
statusCodes.description: Requested resource is no longer available.

statusCodes.name: Length Required
statusCodes.description: Content-Length header field is missing.

statusCodes.name: Precondition Failed
statusCodes.description: One or more request conditions failed.

statusCodes.name: Content Too Large
statusCodes.description: Payload exceeds the server’s limits.

statusCodes.name: URI Too Long
statusCodes.description: URI exceeds server’s processing limits.

statusCodes.name: Unsupported Media Type
statusCodes.description: Media format not supported by the server.

statusCodes.name: Range Not Satisfiable
statusCodes.description: Requested range not available for resource.

statusCodes.name: Expectation Failed
statusCodes.description: Expectation in Expect header could not be met.

statusCodes.name: I'm a Teapot
statusCodes.description: Server refuses to brew coffee with a teapot.

statusCodes.name: Misdirected Request
statusCodes.description: Request sent to a server unable to produce response.

statusCodes.name: Unprocessable Content
statusCodes.description: Server understands content but cannot process it.

statusCodes.name: Locked
statusCodes.description: Resource is locked.

statusCodes.name: Failed Dependency
statusCodes.description: Request failed due to dependency failure.

statusCodes.name: Too Early
statusCodes.description: Request is too early and might be replayed.

statusCodes.name: Upgrade Required
statusCodes.description: Client must switch to a different protocol.

statusCodes.name: Precondition Required
statusCodes.description: Server requires request to be conditional.

statusCodes.name: Too Many Requests
statusCodes.description: Client sent too many requests in a given time.

statusCodes.name: Request Header Fields Too Large
statusCodes.description: Header fields are too large for the server.

statusCodes.name: Unavailable For Legal Reasons
statusCodes.description: Access to the resource is restricted legally.

statusCodes.name: Internal Server Error
statusCodes.description: Server encountered an unexpected condition.

statusCodes.name: Not Implemented
statusCodes.description: Server does not support the request functionality.

statusCodes.name: Bad Gateway
statusCodes.description: Invalid response from upstream server.

statusCodes.name: Service Unavailable
statusCodes.description: Server is temporarily unable to handle requests.

statusCodes.name: Gateway Timeout
statusCodes.description: Upstream server failed to respond in time.

statusCodes.name: HTTP Version Not Supported
statusCodes.description: Server does not support the HTTP version used.

statusCodes.name: Variant Also Negotiates
statusCodes.description: Negotiation configuration causes a circular reference.

statusCodes.name: Insufficient Storage
statusCodes.description: Server cannot store the needed representation.

statusCodes.name: Loop Detected
statusCodes.description: Infinite loop detected while processing request.

statusCodes.name: Not Extended
statusCodes.description: Further extensions are required for the request.

statusCodes.name: Network Authentication Required
statusCodes.description: Client must authenticate to gain network access.
